_readme: Redirect stubs for the old GoDaddy site's URLs (flat paths, no trailing slash). The build writes <from>/index.html at each old path: meta refresh + JS location.replace to the target, a visible 'This page has moved' link, rel=canonical to the target and noindex; never in the sitemap or navigation. 'pages': {from, to, note?}; 'to' must be a real route of this site. 'people': old slugs of person pages; each is matched to data/team.json (→ /team/, which has no per-person anchors) or data/alumni.json (→ /alumni/<id>/, the alumnus's own page); unmatched slugs go to /team/. 'aliases': old slug → current id for misspelled slugs. Paths are written without the path prefix; the build adds it in preview mode. The build fails if a 'from' collides with a real page or a target does not exist (scripts/check-redirects.mjs). Do NOT add /m/login, /m/reset or /m/create (old site-builder internals).
